goal: Find and understand a Workshop capability

steps.title: What this capability is
steps.content: Turns source-bound machine capability declarations into plain-language explanations that people can search, filter, preview, and inspect at increasing levels of detail.

steps.title: Why it matters
steps.content: People can understand what a capability does, what it needs, what it produces, and what remains unknown before choosing or changing an interface.

steps.title: Beginner-safe operations
items: Search and preview a capability without changing it

steps.title: Common mistakes
items: Treating a declared capability as runtime proof

steps.title: Failure modes and recovery
items: An explanation may be incomplete when the source is incomplete
